body.input: [T8 parallel-tools] In a single response, call BOTH at the same time: (1) execute-tool with toolName='cortex-write', instanceId='hermes', input={'path':'/memories/t8-parallel-test', 'content':'T8_PARALLEL_OK'} to write a memory node, and (2) execute-tool with toolName='chat-settings' and instanceId='hermes' (instanceId='hermes' is REQUIRED on this call - never omit it) to read the chat settings. Check that cortex-write returned a responsePath and chat-settings returned a selectedSkill. End your reply with STEP_OK if both tools ran and returned their result shape, or FAILED: <reason> only if a tool errored or did not run.
